title: StudySyndicate PMP Study System MVP Specification
purpose: Machine-readable contract for the PMP study engine: entities, exercise taxonomy, grading doctrine, source/provenance model, competency mapping, weakness policy, session modes, and phased MVP build order.
notFlashcardApp: StudySyndicate is a study system, not merely a flashcard app.

sourceHierarchy.name: User notes, course notes, and video notes

copyrightBoundary: Preserve copyright boundaries; never copy paid question banks wholesale.

coreEntities.name: Source
coreEntities.purpose: Attributable origin of study material with copyright boundary.

coreEntities.name: Competency
coreEntities.purpose: PMP exam-version domain, task/enabler, delivery approach, and weighting.

coreEntities.name: Concept
coreEntities.purpose: Atomic PMP idea with plain-English meaning and PMI exam logic.

coreEntities.name: Card
coreEntities.purpose: A study prompt/answer unit that may carry multimedia.

coreEntities.name: MediaAsset
coreEntities.purpose: Local blob handle for image, audio, or video.

coreEntities.name: Exercise
coreEntities.purpose: A typed exercise variant generated from a concept/card.

coreEntities.name: Rubric
coreEntities.purpose: Conceptual scoring definition for free-recall answers.

coreEntities.name: ReviewAttempt
coreEntities.purpose: A single graded interaction feeding scheduling and weakness.

coreEntities.name: MasteryStat
coreEntities.purpose: Derived mastery/weakness at card, concept, competency, and domain levels.

gradingModes.mvpDependency: semantic-local-ai-grading is not an MVP dependency

recommendationPolicy.note: Initial configurable policy, not immutable mathematics.

scopeBoundaries.note: Do not prematurely implement cloud sync or AI grading.

acceptanceContract.statement: Every Concept, Card, and Exercise can carry Source attribution.
Concepts map to exam version, domain, task/enabler, delivery approach, source, and weight.
All nine core entities are represented in the local Dexie/IndexedDB model.
Cards and concepts support text, image, audio, and video.
All thirteen exercise types are enumerated and gradable.
Recall grading supports exact, tolerant, synonym, rubric, and self-grade modes without requiring exact wording for concepts.
Weakness is tracked at card, concept, competency, and domain levels and drives a configurable practice queue.

JSON export/import round-trips the complete structured study dataset, including media records, metadata, provenance, and stable media references, without embedding binary media payloads. Portable binary media bundling remains deferred.
